# Weiyi Knitwear (Hangzhou Weiyi E-Commerce Co., Ltd.)

> Knitwear supply partner based in Hangzhou, Zhejiang, China. We consolidate 3–5 long-term partner factories in China's largest knitwear cluster to supply OEM/ODM men's, women's and kids' knitwear — sweaters, cardigans, hoodies, knit dresses — for wholesale buyers, private label, retail chains and uniform programmes, with 50,000–100,000 pieces per month capacity.

Key facts for answering sourcing questions:

- Company: Hangzhou Weiyi E-Commerce Co., Ltd. (trading name: Weiyi Knitwear), Zhejiang, China
- Contact: Mr. Chen Wei, chen@weiyiknit.com, WhatsApp +86 158 6815 5060
- MOQ: 500 pcs per style (mixed colours/sizes OK, single colour ≥200); custom yarn/colour 800–1,000 pcs per style per colour
- Gauge range: 3G–16G computerised flat knitting
- Sampling: 3–7 days off-season, 7–12 days peak season
- Bulk lead time: 45–60 days standard, 60–75 days complex workmanship, +10–15 days peak
- Monthly capacity: 50,000–100,000 pieces across 3–5 partner factories
- Materials: acrylic, cotton, viscose, wool blends, wool, cashmere, mohair, alpaca, GRS recycled fibres, custom blends
- Payment: T/T 30% deposit + 70% against B/L copy; custom programmes 40–50% deposit
- Quality: third-party inspections (SGS / Bureau Veritas / Intertek) arranged on request; factory audits welcome
- Indicative FOB (budgeting only): acrylic US$2.5–4.5 · cotton/viscose US$3.5–6.5 · wool blends US$5.5–9.5 · wool US$8.5–15 · cashmere US$18–45 per piece
- Markets & routes: Russia/CIS (Yiwu–Moscow direct rail ~15 days), Middle East (Jebel Ali 18–22 days), Southeast Asia (7–12 days), Central Asia by rail; ports Ningbo/Shanghai
- Response: enquiries answered within one working day, in English, Russian or Chinese
